name: PR Files changed tab groups files by role (Smart Diff) and toggles to original order
description: From PR #482, open the Files changed tab: the reviewer-ordered diff shows the Core group (seeded src/** files classify as core), then switching to Original order shows the flat GitHub list with a seeded file path. Model-free (GET /pulls/:id/smart-diff is a deterministic classifier), works before any review. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).
